newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Mosenergo still sees ADRs this year.
newsitem.headline: Mosenergo still sees ADRs this year.

text.p: Mosenergo is still planning to issue Level-One American Depositary Receipts this year, the head of the company's securities department said on Thursday.
"We proposed issuing ADRs this autumn and up till now we are following the plan," Natalya Khokholkova told Reuters.
She said documents necessary for the issue were now being considered by lawyers in New York.
Mosenergo ADRs, issued as private placement under U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission rule 144A/S, are already traded on international markets.
Mosenergo ADRs were traded at DM 42.10 at 1252 GMT on the Berlin Bourse.
UES owns 49 percent of AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii Mosenergo, corporate investors hold 33 percent of stake and households own 18 percent.
